eyebrow: One plan, built for one value

steps.label: First run
steps.sub: SQL Server sniffs that call's parameter value

steps.label: Skewed column
steps.sub: 2% Cancelled vs. 90% Shipped, wildly different plans

steps.label: Reused
steps.sub: the wrong-shaped plan is cached for everyone

code:
SELECT qs.min_elapsed_time, qs.max_elapsed_time,
    qs.execution_count, st.text
FROM sys.dm_exec_query_stats AS qs
CROSS APPLY sys.dm_exec_sql_text(qs.sql_handle) AS st
ORDER BY (qs.max_elapsed_time - qs.min_elapsed_time) DESC;
caption: Same cached plan, huge gap between min and max elapsed time.

code:
-- Fix 1: force a fresh, freshly-sniffed plan every time
SELECT OrderID, OrderDate, TotalDue
FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader
WHERE Status = @Status
OPTION (RECOMPILE);

-- Fix 2: Parameter Sensitive Plan optimization (SQL 2022+)
-- caches multiple plans, picks by parameter value automatically
caption: PSP is on by default for eligible queries at 2022+ compat level.
